skills.name: Blessing of the Fairy
skills.description: Grants 1 skill level for every 10 levels your highest level character has. Blessing of the Fairy and Empress's Blessing do not stack, so only the strongest skill will be active.

skills.name: Empress's Blessing
skills.description:
For every 5 levels on your highest level Cygnus Knight or Mihile character, this skill will gain 1 Skill Point. Blessing of the Fairy and Empress's Blessing do not stack, so only the strongest skill will be active.
This skill can reach a max of Lv. 30, based on your Cygnus Knight or Mihile character's Noble Mind skill.

skills.name: Chain Arts: Pursuit
skills.description:
Use your chain to grapple to a platform or enemy. Press the skill key to launch the chain horizontally or at a vertical angle.
Striking horizontally only targets monsters, while striking vertically only targets platforms within a certain distance. While airborne, you can strike downward to temporarily slow your descent.
If the Skill key is pressed again while the chain is tethered, you will quickly move to the target location. When the chain is tethered and while moving with the skill, you become temporarily stealthed where you cannot be hit, and attacking or using skills will deactivate the stealth. The use of some skills will not deactivate Dark Sight.
Enemies struck by the skill are briefly slowed.
Chain Arts: Pursuit can be used while using your other skills and is not affected by cooldown reset.
[Up + Skill key] Launches 45 deg. upward
[Down + Skill key] Launches 45 deg. downward

skills.name: Chain Arts: Thrash
skills.description:
Press the Attack Key to whip your chain forward, then bring it crashing down. Enemies hit by the 2nd strike are pushed back. Foes struck by the chain are slowed for a short time.
Other attacks can be used between the 1st and 2nd strikes to inflict enhanced damage.
Can be used while using your other skills.

skills.name: Summon Scimitar
skills.description: Summons a scimitar to instantly cut through enemies. Impervious to Knockback while casting. Usable while airborne and with your other skills.

skills.name: Shadowstep
skills.description: Jump a second time in mid-air. Press the up key at the same to move upward. The jump distance increases with the skill level.

skills.name: Chain Arts: Thrash II
skills.description: Enhances Chain Arts: Thrash's second hit.

skills.name: Muscle Memory
skills.description:
Extensive training with a varied assortment of weapons increases the damage of all of your attacks. Whenever you switch summoned weapons, you execute a bonus attack and receive the Muscle Memory buff. The additional attack is unaffected by attack reflection and doesn't deactivate Dark Sight.
This buff stacks up to the number of summonable weapons you possess (excluding Chain Arts). Summoning any weapon besides the last one used will refresh this buff. 
Muscle Memory is not affected by effects that increase buff duration and the bonus hit effect is not affected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: Weapon Mastery
skills.description: Increases Mastery with all summoned weapons, as well as your Chain Arts.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Your physical training grants you a permanent bonus to LUK and DEX.

skills.name: Wisdom of Shadows
skills.description: Call upon your training as a Shadowdealer to permanently increase your Attack Power, Critical Damage, Critical Rate, and Avoidability.

skills.name: Summon Claw
skills.description: Summons a claw weapon that strikes downward diagonally. Impervious to Knockback while casting. Only usable while airborne. Can be used while using your other skills.

skills.name: Summon Shuriken
skills.description: Summon a spinning shuriken that then explodes, maiming enemies and knocking them back. Unaffected by attack reflection. Can be resisted by some enemies. Dark Sight is not deactivated from use and explosion.

skills.name: Weapon Booster
skills.description: Consumes MP to increase the Attack Speed of all weapons for a short time. Must have a Chain equipped.

skills.name: Chain Yank
skills.description: Launches a chain to a targeted location, whipping you forward as it's reeled back in.

skills.name: Chain Arts: Thrash III
skills.description: Enhances Chain Arts: Thrash's second hit.

skills.name: Muscle Memory II
skills.description: Your continued training and familiarity with your weapons enhances their deadliness. Overrides the effects of Muscle Memory, except for the passive bonus to Summoned Weapon skill damage, which is stacked.

skills.name: Determination
skills.description: Permanently increases Max HP, Status Resistance, Elemental Resistance, and Knockback Resistance through constant training.

skills.name: Cheap Shot

skills.name: Summon Shotgun

skills.name: Summon Daggers

skills.name: Chain Arts: Thrash IV

skills.name: Cheap Shot II

missing.skill: Apocalypse Cannon Boost / Chain Arts: Maelstrom Boost / Chain Arts: Void Strike Boost / Muscle Memory Finale Boost / Venom Burst Boost (None)
missing.why: MISSING — IDs not located. No Boost core named for any of this class's 5th-job skills exists among the 400004xxx names in Skill/40000.img (GMS 270); V-skill Boost cores live in Skill/50000.img, scanned by a separate worker. Passive cores with no frames, so no visuals missing.

notes: Beginner book job 6001 was pulled via the raw WZ API: the skillbook API fails it on every attempt (WZProperty cast error / OutOfMemory), like jobs 6000/6002/10000.

Cadena's 5th-job set is the 4 class-specific actives (Apocalypse Cannon, Chain Arts: Void Strike, Chain Arts: Maelstrom, Muscle Memory Finale) plus shared Thief V Venom Burst; all-class common V skills plus Might of the Nova are out of scope as in every other completed class.
HEXA book 6414 is complete at 35 skills incl. Origin Chain Arts: Grand Arsenal and Brutal Rampage; IDs 64141015-19 are unassigned in the book, not missing data.
Beginner book 6001 contains a skill literally named 'Test' (60011006) and several invisible no-name skills, listed as skill-<id> with their frames/icons where retrievable.
Ball frames are projectile sprites preserved as 'ball' arrays.

WZ fallback repair: a second-pass layer-key bug misfiled a few retried frames under numeric keys (found in 6 skills across the branch, fixed and re-extracted); grapple ball groups (Grappling Heart 9 frames) are grouped sub-animations, recovered after the fix.
